findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_fashion_models, list_venues, get_generation, get_account · Private data: list_models, list_fashion_models, list_venues, list_poses, upload_image, create_generation, get_generation, get_account, create_template_set, list_template_sets, delete_template_set, list_ready_template_sets, get_ready_template_set, create_catalog_job · Public sink: upload_image, get_account · Destructive: upload_image, create_template_set, delete_template_set.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_fashion_models, list_venues, get_generation, get_account · Private data: list_models, list_fashion_models, list_venues, list_poses, upload_image, create_generation, get_generation, get_account, create_template_set, list_template_sets, delete_template_set, list_ready_template_sets, get_ready_template_set, create_catalog_job · Public sink: upload_image, get_account · Destructive: upload_image, create_template_set, delete_template_set

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
